meta.title: Shaadioo
meta.description: Plan every wedding event with your family, share invitations on WhatsApp, and know exactly who's coming.

notFound.title: This link isn't available.

comingSoon.body: We're putting the finishing touches on accounts. You'll be able to create your wedding here very soon.

hero.title: From roka to reception, all in one place.
hero.body: Plan every event with your family, send invitations your guests open on WhatsApp, and know exactly who's coming.
hero.imageAlt: A guest's invitation on a phone, showing three events and a confirmed RSVP for three guests.

workspace.title: One family workspace. Total peace of mind.
workspace.body: From headcounts for every ceremony to every rupee spent, the whole family works from the same plan.
workspace.imageAlt: The family workspace, showing confirmed guests by side, the share of guests who replied, recorded expenses, recent family activity and guest status for the Sangeet.

problem.title: Right now, your wedding lives in fifty places.

items.whatsapp: A family WhatsApp group with 400 unread messages
items.excel: A guest list in someone's out-of-date Excel sheet
items.vendors: Vendor phone numbers saved in five different phones
items.photos: Photos scattered across every guest's camera roll

problem.closing: Shaadioo brings it all into one quiet, shared plan.

plan.title: Plan together, without the chaos.
plan.body: Invite parents, siblings and friends to help. Assign tasks, and follow every event from roka to reception.

points.two: Every important change recorded in an activity log

plan.imageAlt: A task list with two completed tasks and one in progress, each assigned to a family member.

invite.title: Invite beautifully. Zero app downloads.
invite.body: A personal invitation link for every family, shared on WhatsApp or by email. Guests reply in seconds: no app, no sign-up, no password.

points.one: One link per household, not per person
points.two: Each family sees only the events they're invited to

invite.imageAlt: Two household invitations: the Kapoor family attending with four people, and the Singhal family who have opened their link.

numbers.title: Know your exact numbers at all times.
numbers.body: See the confirmed headcount for every ceremony, and every rupee spent along with who paid it.

points.one: Amounts in rupees, lakhs and crores
points.two: Record who paid: Papa, Chacha or the groom's family

numbers.imageAlt: Recorded expenses per ceremony with the number of confirmed guests and who paid, totalling ₹24,50,000.

memories.title: Celebrate, and keep every memory.
memories.body: A simple wedding website, a YouTube livestream for family abroad, and a private photo gallery guests add to by scanning a QR code.

points.one: Guests upload photos without an account
points.two: Website and gallery hidden from search engines

memories.imageAlt: Photo albums per ceremony, a YouTube livestream card and a table QR code for guest uploads.

guests.title: Your guests don't need an app.
guests.body: Built so that even Daadi can confirm in one tap.

whatsapp.title: Opens straight from WhatsApp
whatsapp.body: No app store and no updates. A personal link opens in any mobile browser.

phone.title: Works on any phone
phone.body: Built for budget Android phones on a 4G connection at the venue.

password.title: No passwords, ever
password.body: Each household gets its own private link. There's nothing to remember.

indian.title: Made specifically for Indian weddings.
indian.body: Most wedding software assumes one dinner and individual RSVPs. Indian celebrations work differently.

events.title: Many events, one plan
events.body: Invite close family to the Haldi and 400 people to the reception, from one guest list.

sides.title: Bride's side and groom's side
sides.body: Tag every guest by side and filter your list in one tap.

households.title: Whole households
households.body: You invite the whole family. One link collects the answer for everyone in it.

rupees.title: Rupees and lakhs
rupees.body: Every amount is shown the way Indian families count: ₹12,45,000.

howItWorks.title: How Shaadioo works.
howItWorks.body: Three steps from sign-up to your first RSVP.

one.title: Create your wedding
one.body: Add the couple, your dates and every ceremony with its venue.

two.title: Bring in your family
two.body: Invite parents, siblings and cousins to help. Everyone sees the same plan.

three.title: Share your invitations
three.body: Share each family's invitation link on WhatsApp, and watch the headcount update as families reply.

privacy.title: Private by design.
privacy.body: Indian weddings are deeply personal. We never sell or share your family's data.

links.title: Private invitation links
links.body: Every household's link is unguessable, and you can replace it at any time.

unlisted.title: Hidden from search
unlisted.body: Your wedding website and gallery are kept out of Google and other search engines.

gallery.title: A private photo gallery
gallery.body: Photos stay in your gallery, reached only through your private link or QR code.

delete.title: Delete any time
delete.body: Delete your wedding and every guest's details are permanently removed.

free.a: Yes. Shaadioo is free for couples and families: create your events, invite your family, share invitations on WhatsApp and track RSVPs.

download.q: Do guests need to download anything?
download.a: No. Guests tap the link you share on WhatsApp or by email, and it opens in their phone's browser. They see their events and reply in one tap.

parents.q: Can my parents use it easily?
parents.a: Yes. It's designed for parents and elders: large text, clear cards, prominent numbers and one-tap WhatsApp sharing.

guestList.q: Who can see our guest list?
guestList.a: Only the family members you invite to help plan. Each guest sees only their own invitation and the events they're invited to.

photos.q: What happens to our photos after the wedding?
photos.a: Photos stay in your private gallery for 12 months after the wedding, and you can download them at any time. We keep web-quality copies, not the original full-resolution files.

finalCta.title: Less chaos. More celebration.
finalCta.body: Bring your family together on Shaadioo. Free, with no credit card.

footer.tagline: Wedding planning and invitations for Indian families.
